text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your first report in the channel was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you posted that both gate kiosks were offline with a white screen after badge scan and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

In the meantime, the guard kept checking trucks in by hand on the clipboard. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You posted both lanes working at 11:07.

One thing to check before the postmortem: ticket SUP-5380 has an update logged at 08:12 on 3 Aug ("Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now"). The log doesn't name the author. If that was you, the first report was 08:12, not 10:42.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text:
Gideon's 11:08 AM update on 3 Aug in #inc-vtg-hartford says the screenshot of Mateo's status-page access problem is attached to ticket INC-4821. I replied in the channel, naming you.

I couldn't open INC-4821 itself to confirm the attachment, so this rests on Gideon's message.
